purpose: Minimal modal single-line text input dialog (replacement for Microsoft.VisualBasic InputBox).
called_by: TrayAppContext.cs — for prompting user text input in tray menu interactions
invariants: value is set to the textbox content on OK; unchanged on cancel
TextBox is focused and SelectAll is called when the form is shown
gotchas: Fixed client size (560×155) — not responsive to DPI scaling differences; adequate for short single-line prompts
